name: Browser Act
description: A Claude Code skill that lets Claude drive the browser-act CLI from natural-language prompts — navigating, interacting with, extracting from, and screenshotting webpages. Leverages the CLI's stealth mode, captcha solving, proxy support, and Real Chrome session reuse. Requires browser-act CLI.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `browser-act` (Browser automation CLI for AI agents).

Installs with `claude plugin install browser-act@claude-community` from `browser-act/claude-code-browser-act` (`plugins/browser-act`).

A Claude Code skill that lets Claude drive the browser-act CLI from natural-language prompts — navigating, interacting with, extracting from, and screenshotting webpages. Leverages the CLI's stealth mode, captcha solving, proxy support, and Real Chrome session reuse. Requires browser-act CLI.
